series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits mixed trend direction and moderate seasonality with high noise levels and concept drift. Unstable model rankings and large RMSE spread suggest using a weighted combination with dynamic error adaptation (ade_dynamic_error) to account for shifting model performance, while avoiding ridge stacking due to high noise.

reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → concept drift present; ADE dynamic error weighting adapts to shifting model performance
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.combination_recommendation.top_k=4 AND series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high → use inverse RMSE weights with shrinkage to handle model heterogeneity and high noise
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → different models dominate at different horizons; per-horizon selection captures this structure

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high AND n_windows=2 → ridge stacking overfits with few validation windows
